name: Ognis
description: A fire-breathing viashino Riveteer engineer who stops a train and chases Kitt for the Halo.

timeline.summary: The train stops and Riveteers blow up the rails, then the viashino Ognis tells the passengers she is looking for Henzie's goods.
timeline.quote: "There's somethin' our old pal Henzie owes us, and he knows it

timeline.summary: Kitt flees across the Mezzio rooftops pursued by Ognis and two male viashino.
timeline.quote: the roof shuddered under the shocking weight of the viashino

timeline.summary: Cornered, Kitt drops the gown bag over the edge to fool Ognis and leaps into the chasm singing.
timeline.quote: Opening her hand, she let go of the bag.

timeline.summary: Kitt performs at the Red Room, spotting Ognis and the Riveteers in the audience, and pledges loyalty to the Cabaretti with a song mocking them.
timeline.quote: Pack those vials one by one, up to Park Heights, on the run, bye, bye, boiler
